observations: Significant surface rust is visible on the protective collar and the top shoulder of the cylinder.
A brass valve is installed on the top.
A sticker for 'KUNMAR Gas Plant' is attached to the collar in photo 1.
Embossed text is visible on the side but is obscured by a digital watermark in photo 1.
The base of the cylinder is not shown in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show significant rust and surface wear consistent with a used item.
The capacity markings are not clearly legible in the provided photos, although the size is visually consistent with this class.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be past its safety expiry date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date embossed on the collar or stay plate.

risks.risk: Heavy rust may have compromised the structural integrity of the pressure vessel.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas after cleaning to show the depth of pitting.

risks.risk: The valve may be seized or leak under pressure.
risks.proof: A video showing the valve being operated and a leak test with soapy water.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the embossed weight and date markings on the collar.
Photo of the bottom ring of the cylinder to check for corrosion.
Video of the valve being opened and closed.
response.reason: The item is clearly a gas cylinder. While it shows significant rust and lacks visible date markings, it can be priced at its worst-case value as an expired or scrap-condition unit until further proof is provided.
